content.short: Solana Ventures is an investment fund aimed at growing the Solana ecosystem.
content.description: Solana Ventures directs capital to accelerate growth within the Solana ecosystem and its affiliated networks. By October 2022, the firm had completed 67 investments across gaming, DeFi, and blockchain innovation. Its most recent venture, Fluidity, introduces incentives for crypto use, with every transaction qualifying as a reward. The fund focuses on teams and projects that expand Solana's reach and interoperability across related ecosystems, driving innovation and broader adoption.
